title: Enterprise Support: Invoice and service month selection for retained-fee cash return
content:
Enterprise Support — Invoice and service month selection for retained-fee cash return.

## Decision basis

For retained-fee cash return: The latest billing review by recorded occurrence time identifies the precise original underlying charge and its service month.

## Hypothetical case

For retained-fee cash return: Suppose two hypothetical billing reviews have different recorded occurrence times and identify different original charges. The later review supplies both the underlying charge and its service month; the earlier review’s month is not substituted.
